I've thought about this problem before, and considered running a script in the background that would detect a duplicate image, discard the upload, and redirect to the original one. As it stands, your method of DoS-ing the site could be accomplished no matter where the original image is hosted. Just paste the same URL over and over again, and the image will constantly be re-uploaded.

The only way to fix this is to check each upload against a database of previous images, or put time constraints on uploads. I could do either, but haven't because, so far, Imgoat users don't abuse the site.
